promptIntro: A prompt tells the AI how your organisation replies: its tone, its rules. One is ready. Read it, make it yours, and add others now or later in Writing.
workIntro: Before you reply to an email, the AI can write a proposal of reply. Choose when it does, for every member of the organisation. Whatever you choose, nothing is sent without someone’s confirmation.
needsKey: Needs an AI key, which was not given.
workLater: This can be changed later, in Writing.
finish: Apply and open a first email
tryIt: This is your first email here. Write a few words on what to answer, or nothing at all, then “Write with”. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
tryPrepared: This is your first email here, with the proposal prepared for it. Read it, change what you want, then Send. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
writingIntro: For an email to reply to, when does the AI write a proposal of reply?
writingNoneHint: I open the email and ask for a proposal, or write myself. The content of an email is sent to the AI only then.
writingDraftHint: A proposal waits for me in each email to reply to. Their content is sent to the AI without anyone asking.
writingMailbox: At fetch, as drafts in the mailbox
writingMailboxHint: The same, and each proposal is filed in the Drafts folder of the mailbox, to finish and send from my mail client.
